baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا ... إِلَى نُصُبٍ joins a severe occasion, emergence from graves, speed, and a conspicuous destination.
baseline_models.mechanism: A contained population passes out of burial places and is converted immediately into directed mass motion. The upright marker or boundary supplies a fixed visual attractor, so the speed is not random dispersal but mustering.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day makes the temporal frame itself a decisive occurrence rather than an ordinary date.
Passing from inside to outside supplies the enclosure-to-exposure transition.
The grave as burial place identifies the enclosure from which the crowd emerges.
Quickness opposed to slowness turns emergence into immediate acceleration.
An upright sign or boundary stone gives the moving crowd a salient assembly target.

changed_reading.before: The dead rise quickly and go somewhere.
changed_reading.after: A buried multitude is exposed and instantly mustered toward a fixed, conspicuous point on the severe event-day.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَى نُصُبٍ makes the destination look like a cult stone or altar approached with haste.
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile borrows a recognizable bodily script of eager ritual convergence. That familiar urgency is retained while its object is displaced into the judgment scene, making the crowd's motion look practiced yet no longer self-chosen.

activation_trace.role: Literal haste supplies the eager kinetic manner of the comparison.
The set-up stone for worship or slaughter supplies the ritual destination whose urgency the simile reuses.

changed_reading.before: They run toward a generic landmark.
changed_reading.after: Their compelled convergence is rendered through the bodily memory of people hurrying toward a cultic object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Emergence مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ is directed إِلَى نُصُبٍ, allowing the n-s-b destination to function as a fixed base, return point, or threshold.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse does not depict release as freedom. Leaving one station feeds directly into arrival at another fixed limit, so resurrection becomes a transfer from hidden containment to an assigned threshold.

activation_trace.role: Departure from a place supplies the first side of the transfer.
The grave supplies the abandoned station rather than a final resting place.
The fixed base, return point, or threshold supplies the new terminus of movement.

changed_reading.before: Coming out of graves is simple release from confinement.
changed_reading.after: The exit is only the first half of an inescapable transfer toward a fixed return threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The long measured span, the opposition between what they see as far and what is seen as near, and the fixed promised appointment make the focus sprint a temporal disclosure: imagined delay has collapsed into immediate arrival.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time supplies the apparently vast duration against which the focus day arrives.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the crowd's prior perception of remoteness.
Temporal nearness and an approaching end reverse the perception of delay.
An appointment fixed by time or place turns the focus day into a reached deadline.
The focus quickness gives bodily form to the abrupt collapse from far to near.

structural_cues: The packet orders the immense span at 70:4, the far/near reversal at 70:6-7, and meeting the promised day at 70:42 immediately before the focus yawm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies duration, far/near opposition, and a fixed appointment; I infer that the focus rush spatializes their belated temporal correction. Alternatively, the speed may describe only the manner of assembly.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports fast physical movement on resurrection day.
changed_reading.after: The fast movement enacts the instant in which a supposedly distant deadline becomes present and unavoidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The portrait of an ingrained, quickly disturbed human disposition links panic under harm and withholding under good. The focus turns that private moral instability into collective visible kinetics: the crowd's haste is character disclosed as motion.

activation_trace.role: An inward disposition or nature makes the preceding agitation a durable human pattern.
Anxious greed and rapid disturbance supply the inner motor later externalized as haste.
The breaking-off of patience supplies panic when harm arrives.
Withholding the hand supplies the self-protective contraction paired with panic.
Literal quickness converts the inward instability into a public bodily pattern.

structural_cues: The tightly linked conditional portrait at 70:19-21 precedes the focus crowd, allowing singular human disposition to reappear collectively.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ingrained pattern of rapid agitation, panic, and withholding; I infer recurrence from inward disposition to eschatological crowd motion. Alternatively, the focus speed may be wholly imposed and not expressive of character.

changed_reading.before: The risen crowd happens to move rapidly.
changed_reading.after: Its rapid motion exposes on a collective scale the anxious, self-protective kinetics already lodged within the human subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The crowd had coveted inward admission into a sheltered garden. The focus answers with the opposite vector: outward passage from graves into exposure, followed by directed movement to a fixed point. Container, direction, and agency are all reversed.

activation_trace.role: Hopeful coveting supplies the desired destination and exposes presumed entitlement.
Entry into an interior supplies the desired inward vector.
The garden sheltered by trees supplies the hoped-for protective interior.
Passing from inside to outside reverses the earlier desired direction.
The grave supplies the actual interior from which they are made to emerge.

structural_cues: The explicit 70:38 syntax of hoped-for entry stands five ayat before the focus syntax of exit from graves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coveted entry into a sheltered garden and focus exit from graves; I infer a deliberate directional reversal. Alternatively, the two movements may be separate stages without a direct contrast.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply opens the resurrection scene by emptying graves.
changed_reading.after: It reverses the crowd's hoped admission: instead of being taken inward to shelter, they are driven outward from burial into exposure and summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same crowd is first shown facing and hurrying toward the addressee. The focus preserves its forward-leaning speed but changes the object: social eagerness around a presumed route to bliss becomes compelled convergence on the judgment marker.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face orientation supplies the crowd's initial directed posture toward the addressee.
A hurried approach supplies the earlier bodily analogue for the focus sprint.
Submission within the same posture lets apparent eagerness shade into compelled compliance.
Focus quickness repeats and intensifies the crowd's earlier approach.
The upright marker replaces the addressee as the crowd's fixed object of convergence.

structural_cues: At 70:36-38 the crowd approaches from both right and left while coveting garden entry; at 70:43 the same plural body again moves rapidly toward an object.
Focus 70:43[9] supplies the branchless final verb as a second acceleration cue, so it is retained structurally and not branch-cited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two directed crowd postures and an earlier hurried approach; I infer continuity of group identity and a reversal of its target and agency. Alternatively, the resemblance may be visual only.

changed_reading.before: The altar or marker comparison introduces an unrelated crowd image.
changed_reading.after: The focus reorients the crowd's own earlier eager posture: what looked like self-directed approach becomes involuntary convergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins with a severe event that cannot be repelled and later asserts effective power and the impossibility of getting ahead. After the focus sprint, humiliation catches, covers, and subdues the runners. Their speed therefore demonstrates capture rather than escape.

activation_trace.role: A severe descending event supplies the unavoidable occurrence toward which the scene moves.
Warding off harm supplies the negated possibility of repelling that occurrence.
Effective power able to bring about an act supplies control over the crowd's replacement and destination.
Escaping or getting beyond a pursuer supplies precisely the possibility denied before the sprint.
Overpowering envelopment supplies the result that closes around the runners.
Catching up until near contact makes the following humiliation an overtaking force.
Submissive haste fuses quick motion with compelled obedience at the endpoint.
The focus speed becomes futile acceleration inside an already controlled event.

structural_cues: The unrepellable event at 70:1-2 frames the surah, while not being outstripped at 70:41 and humiliation overtaking at 70:44 tightly bracket the focus sprint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-repellence, effective power, denied escape, overtaking, and submissive haste; I infer that the sprint is compelled and futile rather than evasive. Alternatively, it may be eager movement toward summons without an attempted escape.

changed_reading.before: Speed suggests that the crowd still exercises urgent agency.
changed_reading.after: Their very acceleration displays the impossibility of outrunning the event: haste has become the motion of capture and compliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those earlier defined by giving their backs and turning away are later shown moving hard toward a fixed object. The directional sequence converts refusal into forced reorientation: a summons they avoided now organizes their bodies.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining someone by a summons supplies an attracting force.
Showing the back and averting supplies the prior rejected orientation.
Turning away reinforces deliberate withdrawal from the summons.
Rapid forward motion supplies the bodily reversal of prior aversion.
The upright marker gives the reoriented bodies a definite facing point.

structural_cues: The directional verbs at 70:17 form a call-versus-turning-away sequence, while focus إِلَى supplies an explicit reversed trajectory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies summons, aversion, and later directed haste; I infer a reversal from refused orientation to bodily compliance. Alternatively, the caller at 70:17 and the focus marker may belong to distinct stages without a shared directional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The runners merely obey a new destination.
changed_reading.after: Their rush is the coerced reversal of an old posture: backs once turned away are now aligned toward summons and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The overhead expanse becomes molten material and solid mountains become soft wool. Against that loss of stable high and solid coordinates, the focus n-s-b branch introduces an imposed upright marker. The crowd's rush can therefore be read as orientation under a remade landscape.

activation_trace.role: The sky as what rises and covers supplies the upper coordinate that is deformed.
Molten substances and sediments turn the upper expanse materially unstable.
A high solid mass supplies the terrestrial coordinate that loses solidity.
Soft dyed wool supplies the mountains' transformed material state.
Something set upright and prominent supplies a replacement coordinate in the altered scene.
Quickness makes orientation to that imposed point immediate.

structural_cues: Successive material similes at 70:8-9 remove ordinary sky and mountain stability; the focus closes with another simile centered on a prominent object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deformation of upper and solid landmarks plus a prominent focus marker; I infer that the marker functions as imposed orientation in a destabilized world. Alternatively, the landscape images may provide atmosphere without determining the later destination.

changed_reading.before: The marker is merely where the crowd is going.
changed_reading.after: It is the imposed coordinate toward which bodies align after familiar cosmic and terrestrial coordinates have lost their stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The protected group is characterized by sustained worship, bodily standing for testimony, and vigilant maintenance. The focus cult-stone simile now forms a polarity between durable, chosen orientation and sudden, frantic target-seeking that only resembles devotion from the outside.

activation_trace.role: The particular act of worship supplies chosen ritual orientation.
Stillness and continuance supply duration rather than momentary excitement.
Bodily upright standing supplies a stable posture of responsibility.
Persistent maintenance supplies guarded continuity in worship.
The cult stone supplies an outwardly ritual object for the focus simile.
Sudden haste contrasts with the protected group's durable practice.

structural_cues: The protected portrait is framed by prayer at 70:22-23 and 70:34, whereas the focus comparison compresses orientation into one frantic rush.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sustained worship, standing, guarding, and a cultic focus image; I infer a contrast between inwardly durable practice and its frantic outward mimicry. Alternatively, the focus simile may be purely visual and not evaluate ritual constancy.

changed_reading.before: The cultic comparison means only that the crowd runs eagerly.
changed_reading.after: Its ritual appearance is diagnostic: frantic convergence can mimic devotion while lacking the constancy and guarded responsibility that make orientation meaningful.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins branch-distant bowstring images from n-z-ʿ and s-r-ʿ rather than the immediate lexical senses. It remains anchored in focus emergence, speed, and movement toward something set up; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy of tension and release, not as a translation claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَخْرُجُونَ ... سِرَاعًا ... إِلَى نُصُبٍ provides release, velocity, and a set target.

activation_trace.role: Drawing a bowstring supplies stored tension before release.
Tendon strips twisted into bowstrings give the focus speed a branch-level material link to propulsion.
Passing out from containment supplies the release phase.
The upright set object supplies a visually fixed target for the released motion.

changed_reading.before: The verse shows a crowd running under its own locomotion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the crowd behaves like stored tension released from burial and projected toward a set target.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant s-ʾ-l to s-l-l mapping and therefore must not replace the actual asking sense at 70:1. It remains anchored by the focus's explicit exit from graves; downstream prose should label it a split-root echo that textures emergence as mass slipping-out, not a lexical reinterpretation of the context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ explicitly depicts bodies passing out of burial enclosures.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped image of slipping out activates a furtive or fluid texture for emergence without changing the source phrase's asking sense.
Passing from inside to outside provides the secure focus anchor for the split-root echo.
The graves provide the multiple enclosures from which the slipping-out image can be visualized.

changed_reading.before: Emergence is a clean, singular transition out of graves.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root echo, the graves seem to release a multitude slipping out at once before it accelerates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the snare branches behind a prayer root and the broad setting-up scope of n-s-b, both distant from the immediate readings. The directed focus rush still anchors a trap-like mechanism; downstream prose should qualify it as an ironic branch analogy, never as the lexical meaning of prayer or نُصُب here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سِرَاعًا ... إِلَى نُصُبٍ depicts rapid movement toward something set up and prominent.

activation_trace.role: Set snares provide the cross-domain trap image while remaining distinct from the contextual prayer sense.
Setting something upright and prominent, whose branch scope includes a trap, supplies the fixed snare-like destination.
Quickness makes the crowd close on the possible snare before deliberation can intervene.

changed_reading.before: The crowd's target is a neutral marker or cultic object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the set object behaves like a snare: the crowd's own rush is the mechanism by which it enters capture.

strongest_changes: The far/near sequence turns physical speed into the collapse of imagined temporal delay at a fixed appointment.
The hoped-for inward entry to a sheltered garden is reversed into forced outward emergence from graves.
The anxious human disposition of 70:19-21 becomes collective visible motion rather than remaining an interior trait.
The denial of outstripping and the humiliation that overtakes the crowd recode speed as capture and compelled compliance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses time, direction, ritual posture, and agency into one crowd movement. Context repeatedly preserves the same bodily energy while reversing its value: eager approach becomes coerced orientation, desired entry becomes exposure, and apparent speed becomes proof that the promised event cannot be outrun.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus n-s-b image can remain simultaneously a conspicuous marker, cult stone, and exploratory fixed threshold; context does not force one branch.
The link between human anxious disposition and resurrection haste may describe character disclosure or only a visual recurrence.
The cosmic-landmark, bowstring, split-root, and snare models are branch-supported analogies but should remain explicitly exploratory.
